name: Reveler of Stories (Great Beast)

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Great Beast form.

traits.name: Moral Quandary
traits.summary: As a Bonus Action, a creature can recite the moral of a story of the reveler's theme: for 1 hour it can't take Reactions and its AC is 4 lower.
traits.text: As a Bonus Action, a creature can recite the moral of a story that shares the theme of the reveler's Storied Form. The reveler is weakened for 1 hour: it can't take Reactions and its AC is reduced by 4.

traits.name: Storied Form (Great Beast)
traits.summary: This is the Great Beast form: it embodies tales of terrible monsters.
traits.text: The reveler takes one form: Great Beast, Hero or Witch. The form sets some traits and the theme of stories it embodies (powerful monsters, brave heroes, wicked magicians). This block is the Great Beast form.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Three Thrash attacks; one can be its Fabled Assault when ready.
actions.text: The reveler makes three Thrash attacks. It can replace one with its Fabled Assault if that is ready.

actions.name: Thrash
actions.text: A blow of storybook force: 18 (3d8 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Consuming Bite (Fabled Assault, Great Beast)
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. One creature within 5 ft (save at Disadvantage if already grappled): DC 17 Con save, 8d8 Necrotic (half on a success); a failure is Grappled (escape DC 15) and Restrained. It gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the damage.
actions.text: Constitution save, DC 17, one creature within 5 feet (the save is made with Disadvantage if the reveler is grappling the target). Failure: 36 (8d8) Necrotic damage, and a Huge or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 15) and Restrained until the grapple ends. Success: half damage only. Pass or fail, the reveler gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage the target took.

reactions.name: Dramatic Reversal
reactions.trigger: It is hit by an attack roll.
reactions.summary: Reaction: +4 AC against the attack that hit it, possibly turning it into a miss.
reactions.text: Trigger: an attack roll hits the reveler. Response: it adds 4 to its AC against that attack, which can turn the hit into a miss.

summary: A fiend born of old stories that hammers with storybook force, here in a monstrous form that bites and grapples.
